how_to_announce_a_partner: 1. Save the partner logo in images/partners/ as a PNG with a transparent background or an SVG, at least 600 px wide. Use a short file name with no spaces, for example acme-bank.png.
2. Copy the example below into the partners list, fill in every field and set show to true.
3. level must be one of the names in levels. Partners are shown in the order of levels, then by announced date, newest first.
4. Run python3 build.py. The partner then appears on the home page, at the top of the Partners page and in the footer of every page.
5. To take a partner down without deleting the entry, set show to false and build again.
6. Never add a partner until the agreement is signed and the partner has approved the logo and the wording in writing.

example.name: Partner name exactly as the partner writes it
example.announcement: One or two sentences the partner has approved, for example: Acme Bank joins Ghana at 70 UK as Official Partner of the Royal Jubilee Gala.
